$comment: Generated from the Project type in src/content/types.ts by scripts/project-schema.mjs. Edit the type and run `npm run schema`, not this file.
title: Project

summary.description: One- or two-line summary shown on the grid tile. *Editorial* — seeded by the import script with the abstract's first sentence until an editor writes one.

abstract.description: *Survey (Q14).* The researcher's own abstract, shown verbatim and searched fuzzily.

completionYear.description: *Survey (Q7).* Year the project was completed — a primary filter.

firePhases.description: *Survey (Q9).* Where in the fire cycle the work sits. A primary filter.

publicationStatus.description: *Editorial.* Publication state of the underlying research. The survey does not ask, so it is absent unless an editor sets it — and nothing is shown rather than a guessed "Unpublished" badge on work that is in fact in a journal.

projectType.description: *Survey (Q11).* "Testbed Evaluation", "Research Study", or the respondent's own text.

irbApproved.description: *Survey (Q8).* IRB approval. Records where this is false never reach the UI — `normalize.ts` drops them at the boundary, implementing the survey's own skip logic in the one place it cannot be forgotten by a future page.

geo.description: *Survey (Q13).* Geography, for the landing-page GACC map.

note.description: Optional free-text refinement shown on the X-ray page, e.g. "Front Range".

states.description: Two-letter postal codes. Optional backstop; not asked in the current survey.

takeaways.description: *Survey (Q15).* Major takeaways, in the researcher's own words.

needs.description: *Survey (Q16).* End-user needs paired with recommendations, verbatim. Also the input to the landing-page synthesis.

papers.description: *Survey (Q17).* Publications, tech notes, presentations or reports.

container.description: Journal, report series, or site the item was published in.

doi.description: Bare DOI (`10.1175/WCAS-D-21-0042.1`), not a URL — the `https://doi.org/` prefix is added at render time. Storing it bare keeps one canonical form, so the same value can be a link and a dedupe key.

published.description: Counted in the "projects analyzed" stat only when true. Lets editors stage a project in the CMS before it should affect the public count. Note this is *editorial* visibility on this site — distinct from `publicationStatus`, which describes the underlying research in the literature. A project can be published here while its paper is still in review.
